title: Unit Event — At The End of The Unraveled Thread

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread
meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! is all set for their first TV appearance. However, the show's MC just happens to be the leader of the very group Shizuku used to be in, Cheerful * Days. As excited as she was about making their shoot a success, this surprise reunion has Shizuku...

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm finally done with my homework.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's gotten very late.
I need to get ready for tomorrow and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My uniform looks okay and I've already put the textbooks I need for tomorrow in my bag. That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, my phone!
I'm always forgetting it, so I really should...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I wonder if the producer for iHaz replied back yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They'll need to let us know soon if we're going to be appearing, so I'll check right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... Press the power button and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm...?
My screen's still black.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh dear. Is it broken?
I may need to have a repair person look at it tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll just ask the others about that email tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still... I can't believe we're really getting a chance to appear on TV as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was hoping that we'd receive an opportunity like this someday, but not this soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We weren't even able to join an agency in the beginning and had no idea if we'd actually be able to do anything as idols.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (However, against all odds, we succeeded in putting on a solo show, which led to us being asked to appear on TV...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And this appearance will give us an opportunity to take a step towards becoming idols who are worthy of doing shows at the Dome.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But our fans are all looking forward to seeing us in an entirely new format. On TV...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our segment is only supposed to be about five minutes long, but I'll need to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to prepare well for this...
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm running late. Helping the teacher carry all those worksheets took much longer than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being a little late, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-Hey...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You all seem a bit down for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have you had a chance to check your inbox, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My inbox?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, actually, I haven't...
My phone wouldn't turn on when I tried to yesterday and I was thinking about having someone look at it later...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I realized this morning that it just wasn't charged because the cable wasn't plugged in all the way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But you mentioned my inbox.
Has our TV appearance been cancelled...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, it hasn't. It's just...
We just received word that the MCs for our appearance has changed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The MC...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Some members of U-Symphonium were originally scheduled to be the MCs when we appeared...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But their lead isn't feeling well, so they had to ask a different group to replace them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, that's terrible.
I really hope she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, can you tell me which group is going to be replacing them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: Shizuku got another solo photo shoot for a magazine cover. This is clearly favoritism.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess a pretty face is all they care about. We're clearly better at singing and dancing than she is.

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: You said it...

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: I'm glad to finally be rid of her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How do you feel about this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well...
I am a little wary of having to talk to them again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, after we decided that we're going to appear on TV, I've been preparing myself for this sort of eventuality.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, please don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More importantly, let's do our best to make the most of our very first appearance on TV!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
She's right! Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, also...!
They included a few possible meeting dates in their reply. We wanted to ask which works best for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
I'm really sorry for not checking sooner.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We can check to see which date works best together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I should be free to meet whenever...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye, Shizuku, Airi! See you after school!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and Minori sounded really excited. And so am I now that we have a meeting date set.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same...
Minori's apparently so excited that she's been practicing talking every night with her plushies.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Really?
Minori really does have a wonderful work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll need to do my best as well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And I'll do my best to try to help you if something does ever come up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you sure about this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: About having to appear with Cheerful * Days. You made it seem like everything was fine when Minori and Haruka were with us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But my guess is that you don't feel great about this. I mean, they essentially chased you out after saying some really horrible stuff about you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Appearing alongside them means having to talk to them. Face to face.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, it's not just that...
You also have to keep smiling while in front of the cameras...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no way that's gonna be easy for you. It might feel like ancient history at this point, but you'll be reopening some old and ugly wounds.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, if you don't feel good about this, please tell me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If any part of you is afraid that you're going to ruin our TV appearance... Get that out of your head and don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so kind of you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
I'm always kind, aren't I?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, you are.
You're always so kind and incredibly thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... I'm okay, really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right that I'm not completely fine with this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nothing will change if I decide not to do this TV appearance with Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And if nothing changes...
I'll keep having reservations about Cheerful * Days, which will force you all to keep worrying about how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really don't want that to happen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I see this as a big opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If we all appear together alongside them and make our segment really fun, that may actually in turn help remedy our worries.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, please don't worry about me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More importantly, I want to do everything I can to ensure that our first TV appearance goes well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...
Sounds like your mind's already made up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, alright!
If you're willing to say that, I'm not pulling any punches!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! is making its very first TV appearance... I know our segment's short, but people are gonna remember who we are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!
A few days later
TV Station

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I-I'm so nervous...
This meeting's really happening...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but you should try to relax a little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, the producer won't know what to say if you're that visibly petrified.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know...
I'm trying to settle myself down...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But...!
I forget how you actually do that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is more serious than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, Minori.
Whenever you feel this way, just close your eyes and try to focus on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On myself...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Try to focus on what you want to do for this TV appearance and set everything else aside.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For example, it's good to think of multiple ways to answer each question. Do you know what you're hoping to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, um... So...
My guess is that they're gonna ask us about how our solo show went...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is when I want to show my appreciation for everyone who came to see us and those who've been supporting us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I have a feeling they're gonna ask us about our outfits. If they do, I really wanna talk about the fans who made them for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In summary, Minori, you mainly wish to show our fans just how much we appreciate them...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Also, if some people decide to become our fans after seeing us on this program...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to tell them that I'm gonna work really hard to inspire hope in them and wish for their support!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I take it you feel much better now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...? Whoa, you're right!
My heart's still beating pretty hard, but I feel a lot calmer now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Your idea worked so well!
Thank you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice one, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
I was also really nervous during my first meeting for a TV show, so I know how you feel right now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
So, this is normal for everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I thought my heart was going to jump out of my chest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I gradually got used to it as I started receiving more and more of that sort of work...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Minori, I'm sure you'll do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
If I can learn to stay cool and calm like you guys...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Apologies for the wait!
My other meeting went on longer than expected...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you must be the producer for iHaz. It's nice to meet you. My name is Haruka Kiritani of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm Airi Momoi, also from MORE MORE JUMP! Thank you for agreeing to meet with us today! We've been looking forward to speaking with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'm Shizuku Hinomori of MORE MORE JUMP! We really appreciate this opportunity to appear on your program. We promise to do our very best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... U-U-Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm Minori Hanasato!
Thank you very much for contacting us about this offer! And... And, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Shank you for having us today...!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Hahaha. I can see that you're all full of energy. As I said in my email, I'm very much aware of who you all are.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Please, sit.
I'll pour us all some tea now. We can talk while munching on some of these snacks.
TV Station

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: So, we'd like for you to all appear on iHaz as part of our “Feature the Future” mini segment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Feature the Future...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Based on its name, I assume it's the segment dedicated to introducing up-and-coming idols.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
We have idols who are currently trending to appear as guests and ask them about their personal lives.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: And the one asking the questions will be, well... Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we heard...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Here's the script for that day.
It includes a list of questions that you can expect to be asked, so please try to have your responses ready by then.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...? Those questions are already in the script?! I was under the impression that everyone thought of those on the spot...!

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Haha. I understand why you're surprised since some shows in fact don't have scripts... However, in general, we ask people to prepare their responses in advance.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: By doing so, shoots go much more smoothly and our idols can talk freely without feeling too pressed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wow! I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I was always amazed by how everyone had all these interesting stories to tell. Now it all makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I used to feel the same way about variety shows way back when.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're all pretty used to this now, but I was just as surprised in the beginning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: However, please keep in mind that these questions are the ones you can “expect” to hear.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: iHaz has earned its reputation for featuring raw and uncut conversations between idols. Surprise stories are always welcome.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: So we're actually looking forward to seeing how you and the MCs interact.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, these sorts of segments don't always end up following the script...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We should be ready to answer any questions that are thrown our way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we really do need to practice!

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Hahaha. There's no need to feel so alarmed. You'll be talking to girls around the same age as you, so as long as we get to see you all having a fun conversation, our viewers will...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm?
Someone's at the door.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
That must be our staff.
Would you mind giving me a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Sorry for the interruption.
There's plenty of snacks to go around, so please feel free to have more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The producer seems like a really busy person...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and he's apparently in charge of a few other programs... Despite that, he took the time to meet with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought so when I read his email, but he seems like a really nice person. It's also reassuring that he's great at explaining things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. If our actual appearance also goes this well...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Excuse me, MORE MORE JUMP!
Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, of course... How can we help you?

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: So, they're shooting a variety show called “Princess's Brunch” in the studio just above us. They're taking a break right now and some folks from there came to say hello to us...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: They're the MCs for the next iHaz... Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Then, when we mentioned that MORE MORE JUMP! is here to meet with us, they said that they'd also like to say hi to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Say hi to us...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: I'm aware that there's some history between you and Cheerful * Days, Hinomori. We heard some rumors through the grapevine not too long ago...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Which is why we were worried that you wouldn't accept our offer to appear on this program.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
And yet, you accepted.
Which tells me that you've prepared yourselves for this.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Even if you don't speak with them today, you will when we shoot. So...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like for you to all meet now instead of later. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was actually hoping to see them as well, so if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is that okay with all of you...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: Then, I don't want to pull them away from the studio, so let's go to them.

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: They should be back upstairs now, so I'll show you all the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wonderful. Thank you very much.
Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Equipment Tech
rows.Line: How's this? Is it good where it is?

rows.Speaker: Sound Tech
rows.Line: Can someone fix that lapel mic?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! This studio's so big...!
With a staff to match...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we don't exactly belong here. Are we really allowed to enter?

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: I've already asked and received permission to show you around. Now, where did Cheerful * Days go...
Oh, hello. Are you here to see us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...
We know you're very busy, so the others and I decided to wait until later to speak with you again... Thank you very much for taking the time out of your schedule to do this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Arisa...)

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line:
Ah, hello.
I'd rather not force you to make the same trip twice. Especially since we asked you to sub in as the MCs on such short notice...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Please, don't mind us!
We're really happy about getting to appear on iHaz! We've been wanting to for a while now!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Yes, we have. Also...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We get to see a familiar face.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
It's nice to see all of you again. I'm glad to see that you're all doing well.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Likewise, Shizuku.
We watched some of your streams. You seem to be having way more fun than when you were with Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We can discuss that another time. For now, we're simply here to greet each other.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We're meeting as two different groups today, but I'm looking forward to appearing alongside all of you.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I know a lot happened between us...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: But iHaz is pretty well known throughout the idol-fan community and has a very passionate staff onboard. So, I want to make the most of this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
So, Shizuku...
As short as the MORE MORE JUMP! segment is going to be, I want to do it right.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm going to give it everything I have, so I hope you will as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh!
U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we will.
We may be a bit rough around the edges since it's going to be our first appearance on TV as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we also plan to give it everything we have. We'll be looking forward to the conversation we're going to have during our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Then, for now, thank you all very much. We'll see you again during the actual shoot.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
You as well, sir. See you then.
Now, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
That... That really made my hairs stand up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can tell something fierce is hiding behind that smile of hers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, she was probably telling the truth...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
She seems to genuinely want the show to go well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which makes sense since she's in a group that's maintained its popularity for so long...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means we can't let our guard down. Let's prepare as much as we can leading up to the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The others seem determined to make sure our shoot goes well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That means I also need to do what I can...)
A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, you've already had your meeting...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, all that's left is the actual shoot... This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know it's not going to be easy, so we'll understand if you feel a little nervous. However, we're very much looking forward to seeing your beautiful smiles on TV!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We're gonna prep as much as we can leading up to it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Which means...
We have to start brainstorming what could come our way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. They may've provided us with a script, but the producer did mention how surprises are always welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We don't know what the Cheerful * Days MCs are going to throw at us, so we need to be prepared to answer some unexpected questions.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
You met with Cheerful * Days at the TV station, yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What were they like...?
It was your first time seeing them after you left, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I was a little nervous at first, but I managed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We greeted each other like normal and agreed to do everything we can for our shoot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I'm gonna be honest, that left a pretty bad taste in my mouth...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, they said some really awful things about you, Shizuku. The least they could do is apologize.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, it seemed like it was more or less all water under the bridge, which is good...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Line: I wish I'd made these realizations sooner when I was still with Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the old me really didn't know what to do... She struggled so much that she couldn't fulfill her duties as the group's lead and ended up leaving... Like you said, I didn't “move on”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I caused you all so much trouble.
So, I really need to tell everyone in Cheerful * Days that...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
What are you rambling on about?
I was just here to say bye to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I was convinced that you were all up a creek since you're trying to be idols without working with an agency, but it sounds like you're all having a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: And you seem to have friends who understand you much better.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: But don't get cocky just because your little solo show made a few headlines and led to your group being given a chance to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how much you can all handle without the aid of others.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Seriously, what's with her?!
Not once did she say that she's sorry!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, she said that she was here just to say bye to us, but she really showed us her teeth there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, she came here because she wanted to trash-talk us? Honestly, that girl...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Arisa's a very hard-working girl who doesn't go easy on others or herself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which is why she hardly ever tells anyone “good luck” or “try harder” like she just did...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Does that mean she's sort of acknowledging me as an idol...?)
A few weeks later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That episode of idol Hazard, a.k.a. iHaz, finally aired last night...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And everybody's going nuts about us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, they are.
A lot of my classmates were also talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're getting a ton of emails and DMs too! They're all people saying how they saw us on TV and what they thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're almost all saying positive things about us. You in particular definitely seem to have a lot more fans now, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I do?!
That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must've been so moved by your story!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It also gave a lot of people an opportunity to learn about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were ultimately shown in a positive light. As worried as I was about this initially, I'm glad we accepted this offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means our first appearance on TV as MORE MORE JUMP! was a resounding success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And since we're getting such a positive response, we might be asked to make another appearance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, this is only our first step. We can't lose sight of our goal... Let's keep doing everything we can to make our show at the Dome a reality!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was still in Cheerful * Days, I only said what was written in the scripts I was given...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But now, I can use my own words to spread hope to our fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which is strange because I wouldn't have been able to not too long ago...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must've been so moved by your story!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm not scared anymore. So...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm going to be myself and spread as much hope as I can with this group.)
